title: Homology transport from the canonical open tensor-stalk chain square
statement: For the ordinary tensor complexes of [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition], let tau be an additive chain iso whose degreewise composition with ambient tensorStalkIso equals restricted tensorStalkIso followed by the stalk of [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso] inverse and the same-germ comparison gamma. Then forgetting restricted k0, applying stalk cohomology to [def-pc-single-complex-open-tensor-restriction-iso], and applying [def-pc-open-derived-additive-stalk-iso] equals the inverse forgetful homology factor, homologyMap(tau), ambient forgetful homology factor and forgotten ambient k. The k maps use comparisonStalkHomologyIso from [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport]. This is conditional only on an explicit chain-square identity, not arbitrary scalar or input coordinates.

source.place: sheaves.tex, lemma-stalk-pullback-modules (Tag 0098); perfect.tex, equation-bc (Tag 0DJ7), ordinary target path; cohomology.tex, exact localization Tags 08HY and 08DW.

proof.text: Construct the termwise inverse pinned tensor comparison a and its additive stalk chain composite rho with gamma. Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext and function extensionality to the given degreewise equality, obtaining tau followed by the forgotten ambient tensorStalkIso equals the forgotten restricted tensorStalkIso followed by rho. Apply homologyMap and homologyMap_comp.

Rewrite beta using openTensorRestriction_representative. Apply openStalk_representative_coherence to a, which identifies the beta and nu composite with homology of rho and the specified endpoint factors.

Use ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso_inv_naturality at restricted tensorStalkIso and mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality at ambient tensorStalkIso. The proved private categorical assembly lemma composes these two equations with the homology chain-square equality and the representative coherence equality. Rewrite the two forgetful maps of composites using map_comp to obtain the statement unchanged.
